bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDGO's current issuer-listed Solana, Ethereum and Morph deployments are native issuer claims. Pinned EVM implementation and complete mint/manager/upgrader role enumeration identify issuer-controlled EOAs, not escrow or message-verifier representation contracts. Native EVM authorities are recorded in Mint Authority; this does not claim independent signer custody or remove their unbounded upgrade and cap-raising power.
